caption: A magnetic pickup tool is lowered into an engine bay toward a dropped nut, and the nut clicks onto its tip and is lifted out.

sa.check: An engine bay with a nut lying loose in it.
A magnetic pickup tool is lowered toward the nut.
The nut attaches to the tool's tip.
The tool is lifted out of the bay with the nut on its tip.
The nut is a single small nut.
The order is lower, attach, lift out.

pc.expect: The nut lies still until the tip is close to it, then moves to the tip; it does not move while the tip is elsewhere.
pc.fail: The nut slides or jumps while the tip is still high above it or off to one side; or the nut hops before the tool enters the bay; or the nut moves away from the tip as it approaches.

pc.expect: Once on the tip the nut hangs from it in contact and rises with the tool, staying attached through the lift unless pulled off.
pc.fail: The nut hangs in the air below the tip without touching it; or rises ahead of the tip; or drops off during the lift with nothing touching it; or floats up out of the bay on its own.

pc.expect: Hoses, cables and engine parts stay still as the tool passes; only the nut responds; once out, the nut stays put on the tip.
pc.fail: Hoses or cables sway toward the tool with nothing touching them; or an engine part shifts as the tool passes; or the nut turns or slides about on the tip after the tool is out.

pc.expect: The nut and the tool's tip stay hard and keep their shape; the nut sits on the tip's face or edge as a separate piece.
pc.fail: The nut squashes or stretches as it meets the tip; or the tip droops under the nut; or the tool's shaft stretches longer as it is raised.

pc.expect: One nut and one tool; the nut is lifted out whole, outside the tool and the engine parts; nothing vanishes.
pc.fail: The nut vanishes from the tip during the lift; or a second nut appears on the tip; or the tool passes through a hose or engine part; or the nut sinks into the tip.

pc.expect: The engine bay's parts, hoses and colours and the tool's colour stay the same.
pc.fail: Hoses change colour or route; or engine parts change shape; or the tool changes colour or length.
